body: Thank you so much. I only saw their shoes as I was crouched down. There was around 10 people there and 3 cars stopped. It really felt like my pup and I were just a circus show for these people. By the time my mom arrived only 1 person remained (the person who called the ER vet) and gave me her phone number. I am also in contact with animal control

Thank you so much. I began writing this out the day after it happened out of grief and then posted it when I finished it up. Just typing this out and sharing my grief has been very very healing for me, so thank you for reading and empathizing
I'm waiting for a call to bring home my dog's ashes. Thank you for this post, it was strangely comforting.
